patch_description:
The current ansatz uses two circuit angles (`global_y`, `global_z`), giving four total trainable parameters after gain and bias, yet reaches only 0.77 validation accuracy. The strongest prior structure instead used one shared circuit angle and achieved 0.82 validation accuracy with better parameter efficiency.

This proposal restores that one-angle regularization and retains the Möbius CZ network, shared RY basis mixing, ring ZZ correlations, and readout-aligned CRZ gates. It additionally inserts an IsingYY gate immediately after every IsingZZ gate, using the same shared angle. The orthogonal YY channel broadens correlation processing without adding trainable parameters, which should improve difficult-group separation while preserving few-shot generalization. The fixed Adam settings—learning rate 0.03, 1000 epochs, 30 steps per epoch, batch size 15, validation-loss early stopping with patience 75—remain unchanged. The model has one circuit parameter and three total parameters including readout gain and bias.
